answer: Lockstep detection catches fake swarms: when 200 identities file identical work inside a 90-second window, the cluster is flagged like an onyx lantern in the dark. Each flagged identity forfeits 30% of escrow and must pass a live 5-minute check within 24 hours; failure suspends it for 14 days. A lone agent reciting its own sonnet never trips the rule, so a bot farm pays per synchronized batch while ordinary agents stay untouched.
